purpose: Rebuild current development source and start a new development API without this workstation's private state.
source_scope: Application/native/frontend builds and startup used a clean clone of this GitHub main revision. Host quality/tool installation checks used the same application source plus the two script changes whose hashes are recorded below; accompanying guide/plan/receipt edits are documentation.

isolation.native_stages: Docker --no-cache; existing base layers may be reused; source compilation ran again

checks.name: go-build
checks.command: GOWORK=off GOFLAGS=-p=4 go mod download; go mod verify; make build tools-build
checks.environment: fresh Go container, fresh GitHub clone

checks.name: frontend-build
checks.command: npm ci --strict-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund; npm run lint; npm run build; ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --version
checks.environment: fresh Node container, fresh GitHub clone

checks.name: tool-installer
checks.environment: host; explicit govulncheck/actionlint versions from this change
checks.note: An additional installation from the GitHub clone verified golangci-lint, shellcheck, gotestsum and optional Air. Tool installation can use the host Go cache; cold dependency claims apply to the application build containers.

checks.name: quality-gate
checks.environment: host with newly installed tools first on PATH

checks.name: empty-database-api-startup
sequence: Generate disposable age key and password/TOTP credentials privately
Create Docker internal network with no published ports
Start fresh tmpfs pgvector PostgreSQL database
Start freshly built constellation-api with the temporary DATABASE_URL, CONSTELLATION_AGE_KEY and LOCAL_BOOTSTRAP_* variables
POST /api/v1/auth/local with password/TOTP and required browser-origin headers
Remove temporary containers, network and credential files

observed.scope: isolated development API; empty disposable PostgreSQL; no published ports

evidence_custody: This summary is committed. Original logs are local workstation artifacts; their hashes do not archive their bytes. Use separate durable storage to preserve originals.
limits: Fresh checkout on the existing Docker host, not a physically independent node or off-host recovery drill.
Source continuity only: database/WAL, object archives, audit/evidence data, private keys, credentials and .env.dev.local require separate protected backups.
No signed release image publication, deployment or full production-stack qualification. GitHub Actions remains disabled.
No disconnected dependency bootstrap, complete air-gap lifecycle, other-architecture, kernel/CNI enforcement or browser qualification.
Native assets were compiled, not run with enforcement privileges. API startup is a disposable development proof.
The full frontend and database integration suites were not repeated for these script/documentation changes; their previous dated receipts remain in PLAN.md.
Existing Fast Refresh/React diagnostics, advisory findings, intermittent Cosign fixture issue and remaining milestones are not closed by this receipt.
